summary: Queue-first request pass reuses four existing Ithaca targets, records the March termination and June hardware-removal gap, and preserves unresolved native offboarding evidence.

data.research_question: What portion of request #1899 can be advanced now without duplicating existing Ithaca termination/offboarding identities?
data.method: Read the request and comments, searched current main for existing Ithaca targets, reused those stable IDs, and reconciled March 2026 termination reporting with June 2026 city-attributed operational/removal reporting.
classification_rules: Reuse stable canonical IDs when materially equivalent targets already exist.
Physical hardware presence does not establish platform operation or data collection.
City-attributed operational status is distinct from vendor-confirmed shutdown, deletion, credentials, audits, and equipment custody.
Cornell University Police and Ithaca Police remain separate networks absent a directed access edge.

findings.finding: Four existing canonical Ithaca targets cover termination compliance, deletion/offboarding, sharing history, and removal work orders and were reused.
March 4, 2026 termination and the 22-camera municipal scope are independently reported.
By June 3, five units remained physically present, while the city said they were no longer operational to its knowledge and awaited Flock confirmation.
Native offboarding, audit, deletion, credential, removal, custody, and sharing records remain unresolved.
